identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][20.c1] Add Linux service control to CSMctl

values.summary: Implemented Linux process service control for CSMctl while preserving Darwin launchd behavior and continuity-safe shutdown.
actual_changes: Added explicit Darwin launchd and Linux process service backends to CSMctl.
Added PID ownership validation, stale and foreign PID refusal, and bounded continuity-safe TERM shutdown on Linux.
Added focused lifecycle, platform-routing, ownership-denial, and shell-syntax proof.
Documented supported Linux Runtime control and macOS-only Observatory boundaries.

actual_validation.purpose: Run the focused CSMctl Linux backend validator.
